title: API request converter (cURL ↔ fetch ↔ axios)
description: Convert `curl` CLI requests (including headers, bearer tokens, and JSON bodies) into clean JavaScript `fetch()` or `axios` snippets without pasting private API keys into online converters.
x-privacyfold-engine: none (plain JavaScript in the browser tab)

input.description: Text to process. Sent to the tool only through the URL fragment / local input.
